prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Six adult friends aged 28 to 43 enjoy a birthday dinner at a long wooden table in a small garden. The birthday woman laughs with the friend beside her while the others talk across the table. A plain cake, simple flowers, and linen napkins add restrained detail. Use balanced golden-hour light and an elegant environmental group composition. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: Make the birthday woman distinctly strawberry-blonde with a short wavy bob, freckles, and a round face. Give the other five guests varied appearances: a clean-shaven short-haired blond man in round glasses, a woman with long straight dark hair, a red-haired man, a woman with a short dark curly bob, and a clean-shaven man with medium brown hair. Nobody shares the same face. Exact 16:9. Frame a wide environmental view with generous scenery at both sides; keep all six main people and their hands inside the central 55 percent of image width.
review: Reviewed generated full image: six distinct adults around a garden birthday table, red-haired birthday woman laughing, cake and flowers clear. Faces, visible hands and tabletop interactions are coherent; warm natural evening light, no writing or logos. All faces remain inside a central 4:3 crop, with extra garden context; outer bodies use the side margins.
